issues.reason: Exact source inventory shows PumpState parent PumpControl.Region1, not PumpControl, so direct containment is not realized.
issues.requirement_quote: Within the PumpControl state, there are three main substates: PumpState, WaterState, and MethaneState.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Transitive containment via Region1 could be read as within PumpControl, but the contract requires direct containment.
issues.title: PumpControl does not directly contain PumpState

issues.expected: PumpControl directly contains WaterState as a child state.
issues.observed: Source inventory places WaterState under PumpControl.Region1, and FCSTM state:WaterState:line:11 parent is Region1.
issues.reason: Direct parent is Region1, not PumpControl.
issues.requirement_quote: Within the PumpControl state, there are three main substates: PumpState, WaterState, and MethaneState.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Transitive containment via Region1 is present but not direct.
issues.title: PumpControl does not directly contain WaterState

issues.expected: PumpControl directly contains MethaneState as a child state.
issues.observed: Source inventory places MethaneState under PumpControl.Region1, and FCSTM state:MethaneState:line:12 parent is Region1.
issues.reason: Direct parent is Region1, not PumpControl.
issues.requirement_quote: Within the PumpControl state, there are three main substates: PumpState, WaterState, and MethaneState.

issues.title: PumpControl does not directly contain MethaneState

issues.basis: inspection_equivalent_facts transitions line 27 resolved_target_ref state:UnspecifiedInitial:line:26 scope PumpControl; verify_facts initial-entry refuted for PumpState; NL3-INIT-1
issues.expected: Owner PumpControl initial pseudostate enters PumpState.
issues.observed: FCSTM PumpControl initial transition line 27 targets UnspecifiedInitial, and Region1 initial entry to PumpState is scoped to Region1 not to PumpControl.
issues.reason: The exact owner-local initial edge owned by PumpControl targets UnspecifiedInitial, not PumpState, and verify_facts shows no reachable path to PumpState from top-level initial.
issues.requirement_quote: The system first transitions to the PumpState substate, where the pump is activated or controlled.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Region1 has an initial entry to PumpState, which could be read as the first entry within PumpControl.
issues.title: PumpControl initial entry does not target PumpState

issues.basis: fcstm_model state PumpState named; reference_inspection_facts actions count 0; NL3-ACTION-1
issues.expected: PumpState includes pump activation or control action on entry/do/exit.
issues.observed: FCSTM model has no actions for state:PumpState:line:10 and reference inspection facts show actions count 0.
issues.reason: No action fact is bound to PumpState in closed model inventory.
issues.requirement_quote: The system first transitions to the PumpState substate, where the pump is activated or controlled.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Behavior may be implied by transitions, but no explicit action is recorded.
issues.title: PumpState lacks required pump activation/control action

issues.expected: A transition with source PumpControl and target WaterState exists.
issues.observed: FCSTM contains PumpState -> WaterState transition line 14, not PumpControl -> WaterState.
issues.reason: Exact transition inventory has no edge from PumpControl to WaterState.
issues.requirement_quote: The system can also transition to the WaterState substate, indicating that the pump is controlling or monitoring the water flow.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: PumpState -> WaterState realizes water flow monitoring within Region1.

issues.basis: NL3 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL3-INIT-1; inspection_equivalent_facts reachability for state:PumpState:line:10 false; verify_facts check_id reachability:state:PumpState:line:10 refuted; inspection_equivalent_facts transitions transition:line:27 source [*] target UnspecifiedInitial owned by PumpControl.
issues.expected: An initial pseudostate edge owned by PumpControl enters PumpState on first entry.
issues.observed: PumpControl initial edge targets UnspecifiedInitial via transition:line:27; Region1 initial edge targets PumpState via transition:line:13, owned by Region1. PumpState is unreachable from top-level initial entry per inspection_equivalent_facts.
issues.reason: The closed FCSTM shows PumpControl's initial transition goes to UnspecifiedInitial, not PumpState, and verify facts refute reachability of PumpState from initial. Owner-local initial entry is absent.
issues.requirement_quote: The system first transitions to the PumpState substate, where the pump is activated or controlled.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Region1 has an initial entry to PumpState, which could be interpreted as the first entry within the Region1 scope, but the contract requires PumpControl ownership.

issues.basis: NL4 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL4-TRANS-1; inspection_equivalent_facts transitions transition:line:14 source PumpState target WaterState; verify_facts reachability for WaterState refuted.

issues.reason: Exact transition inventory lacks the required source-target pair; the only WaterState incoming edge originates from PumpState.
issues.requirement_quote: The system can also transition to the WaterState substate, indicating that the pump is controlling or monitoring the water flow.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: PumpState -> WaterState transition exists and WaterState is a descendant of PumpControl, which may be read as indirect reachability, but the endpoint pair is not PumpControl to WaterState.

issues.basis: NL5 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL5-TRANS-1; inspection_equivalent_facts transition line15 source PumpState target MethaneState; verify_facts reachability for MethaneState refuted.

issues.requirement_quote: Similarly, the system can transition to the MethaneState substate, indicating that the pump is controlling or monitoring the methane flow.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: PumpState -> MethaneState exists and MethaneState is descendant of PumpControl, suggesting indirect reachability, but endpoint pair mismatches requirement.
